build_deprecated_decorator: build a python decorator that marks a function or class as deprecated with a custom help message
create_deprecated_enum: create a deprecated enum class that warns users when any member is accessed
refactor_function_with_deprecated: refactor an existing function to emit a deprecation warning on first call using the deprecated decorator
review_onaccess_metaclass: review the OnAccess metaclass that triggers a callback whenever an enum member is accessed
summarize_deprecation_warnings: summarize how the deprecation module tracks emitted warnings to avoid duplicate FutureWarning messages
